reviews.body: The lamp has been on my desk for three months. The dimmer is smooth and the USB C port is convenient.
Good light output. I wish the base were heavier but it works well beside my monitor.
Fine overall. The touch control is more sensitive than I expected.
Warm mode is comfortable at night and the arm stays where I position it.
Mine arrived with a scratch. Replacement was fine.
Compact and bright enough for reading. Cable could be longer.
Using it in a small office. No flicker that I can notice.
Matches the dimensions listed and fits under my shelf.
Stopped turning on after six weeks.
Bought a second one for my workbench.
